reviews.x: I felt like I had my own steam engine, I suffer from acne and my skin is very oily. I left a lot of money for years on facials, I decided to buy this machine and I'm very happy. I've been testing it for several weeks (I do a weekly cleanup) and it works perfectly. The steam lasts about 20 min and leaves very little, but it is more than adequate. The size is perfect to keep it anywhere and the design has conquered me since I opened the box. I recommend

This, combined with an ultrasonic skin scrubber, has visibly improved my skin more than any kind of scrub, peel, or mask ever has. I love that this facial steamer is meant to be used with other tools and products and just makes everything more effective.  My fiance was a habitual smoker for years before switching over to vaping and recently quit vaping altogether. We've been doing all we can to improve his lung health, and whenever I do a steam treatment for myself I make him sit there for the l

I love my little steamer, i specifically wanted one shaped like this and it has a touch of pink so even better.  It works well and steams up quickly. It’s easy to fill i use bottled or filtered tap water. Be careful with bare skin while using, I did burn my chest once not being careful. The only thing I don’t like it that it’s supposed to be adjustable but the nozzle really only stays pointing one way, even when you try to adjust.

reviews.t: I'll tell you how to use this READ HERE FIRST
reviews.x: If you fill the removable chamber with water holding down the red button.....instead of filling the actually device itself it does not spit water at all and let's out steam for 12 min  This thing is amazing now that I'm using it properly!!!

I bought this item because the reviews stated that it had a lot of Bang for the buck and could be used for salon purposes.. I found that to be absolutely false.. This little steamer only shoots steam out for about 3 minutes tops and then it shuts off.. It was not what I was looking for

reviews.t: Works great, I love this item.
reviews.x: This works so good on face and hands and other dry skin areas. It's easy to use and feels so good. It really hydrates your skin. I use it every week. I will be buying more as gifts for my daughters birthdays.

reviews.t: Nothing to Write Home to Mom About
reviews.x: I’m a mobile aesthetician so I purchased it for travel since traveling with my floor facial steamer was causing too much wear and tear. This portable/ desktop one is horrible! It’s spits out hot water, it takes a while to heat up and once it does there’s not much “steaming” going on, the reservoir is too small, it’s suppose to steam for 30 mins, I would say it’s actually 7-13 minutes maybe if you include the time to takes to get hot. It’s truly made for consumers who don’t know what to expect fr

reviews.t: Caused a 1st degree burn on my chest
reviews.x: Had no idea how much water was appropriate for this thing. Put water in it, plugged it up, I sat in front of it thinking it was safe, next thing I know it's boiling and it starts squirting scalding hot water out and at me. Some of that water landed on my chest and instantly burned my skin which stung for hours. After it finally stopped squirting scalding water, it steamed for about 8 minutes and was out of water. Do not buy! It's dangerous and not worth the money.

After a month of having this product, I have only used it twice. The second time I used it, I smelled smoke coming from the steamer. I thought that I might not have cleaned it well or something, but I only have put water in it. I turned it off and turned it back on and the machine got really hot. I smelled more smoke and I quickly turned it off and never turned it back on again.

I rec’d this on Sunday 3/22 and by Tuesday 3/24 the water tank rubber had fallen off on the tank and the screw top. I guess the heat loosen it up and it would no longer fit. Therefore it wouldn’t keep the pink top on the water tank or the screw top. And the lil plastic pen inside the screw top was melting/chipping away. So I returned it and purchased a different one.
I would give this product zero stars if it were possible. My unit was defective. The water immediately leaked out of the reservoir upon filling it. So, I only got about 3 seconds of steam.

I got this product about a week ago and I have used it just twice. I bought it because I read that a facial steamer is an easy way to open the pores and prepare the face for facial cleanising and masks. I used to take baths before my facial routine to open the pores lol so this product has been a boom for me since it saves me time.  Another exciting thing I notice about this product is that it helps me to breath at night. I have asthma and the warm smoke helps me to open the nostrils so I think

reviews.t: Very Easy to operate, hassle free. Works and feels great!!
reviews.x: Initially upon opening the CkeyiN I was Skeptical. The instructions were extremely simple. I figured there would be impossible list of things to do before operating. However, it was super simple to use. Just like a water steamer should be. Duh!!! It is a big larger than I had expected and it's not handheld like I thought but omg does my face feel amazing. You can't adjust the heat but the temp was just right. Would def recommend! I don't regret buying this!!!

reviews.t: It Helps clean the black head!
reviews.x: I have a lot black head on my nose, and this is perfect machine I am looking for clear out those black head. I use this machine after washed my face, and I usually steam about 10 minuets. My pore at that time is open and those black head around my nose kind of come out, so it is very easy to clean them. Highly recommend for clean out black head and for better nutrition absorption by put a face mask after steaming.

The facial steamer is really compact and sturdy. The shape of the steamer is such that it's easy to handle. The water filter is really small which avoids the wastage of water. It doesn't takes time for the water to start boiling and start to steam. The steamer is best for cold and runny nose too. It has a handle too which makes it much easier to hold and use it.

I just got this steamer and used it for the first time last night. The steam was not how I expected/wanted. Felt more like hot air on my face. And when I looked in the mirror I had black stuff covering my face?? And even in my nose. Black stuff everywhere. I don’t know what this black stuff was but I know I don’t want that going into my pores!

reviews.t: no steam after a 20 minute wait
reviews.x: I was SUPER EXCITED when I received my facial steamer two days before the scheduled date- thank you Amazon!!  Unfortunately, this facial steamer did not produce any steam, rather, just puffs of steam, after waiting 20 minutes for the unit to heat up. I will be returning this unit and seek out a facial steamer that actually produces steam.

I bought this for my friend, who wanted a face steamer. I'm not sure if the unit she received was defective but she was burnt by the water because it splashed at her instead of steaming and it melted the plastic. She also said that she wasn't able to open the back part because of that.

Does the job. I have only used it twice and the cluster of pimples that I had on one cheek have cleared up dramatically. I'm very happy with my results.... A new holy grail to my skincare regimen. The steam helps boost the efficiency of the skin care products you use afterwards

I’ve had this steamer for a few months and already malfunctioning. I’ve only used it less than 10 times. Even when the tank is full, it shuts off. The water leaks and takes a lot of plugging in and out for it to start. When it works, it steams well but I would purchase again

Shipped quickly product worked amazing for about a month then the water spout that you fill started to crack & come apart the washer fell off & it no longer filtered the water properly, so it would shoot water out instead of steam. Now it's inoperable.

I really like the product. Im just so disappointed with the tank. It cracks easily. It seems not sturdy to stand the steam/heat. After having it replace once with the same product and crack happened again im returning and asking for refund.

Super cute, love that it’s jot too big. Use it for getting out blackheads and I love it. This is a good facial steamer and easy to use as well as store. I like using this before putting a face mask on. From Order ID = #113-1340****-6392201

When you hold it very close and move your face from side to side. It works. But it does not blow a lot of steam.  I decide to buy one for about the same price from lonove and it blows 10x the amount of steam although holds less water.

this product is what I need .  Moisturize the skin,open up pores, and help remove blackhead. It’s easy to use and the steam last enough time while I use my facial mask. If there is no water in the water tank, it will auto shut-off.

claims.text: Many reviewers say the steamer works well for opening pores and improving skin, helping with acne, blackheads, and hydration.
Several reviewers report the steamer is easy to use and heats up quickly.
Some reviewers warn that hot water can spit or squirt out and cause burns if you are not careful.
A few reviewers report the unit is defective, leaking water or emitting smoke and overheating.
Some reviewers say the steam only lasts a short time, making it unsuitable for salon or professional use.
